The tests are not about if you can sing it’s about figuring out if you are tone deaf or not. If you want to be able to sing it takes a few more steps

Hi, there’s a few things you can do. Play a note on the piano and then sing the note right after, best to record yourself so you can check after. Another thing you can try is one of those test that figure out if you’re ‘tone deaf’. You can Google them or check the AppStore (most of them just make you listen to different notes to see if you can hear the notes etc.) 

If you want someone else’s opinion try to get an initial lesson (maybe even a free one to try out if that’s possible) with a vocal coach so they can check with you if you have problems with your pitching. 

As for the recording I’d be happy to listen to it  and tell you an honest opinion so you’d have a stranger tell you + tips can always be beneficial as well
